gaps.title: No real‑time temperature compliance monitoring
gaps.detail: Frostbite supplies emergency fridge/freezer trailers to hospitals, supermarkets and event venues, but the research mentions only rapid delivery, not continuous temperature tracking or automated audit reporting required for NHS and food safety standards.
gaps.based_on: Provides emergency and event fridge and freezer trailer hire with rapid on‑site response (within 4 hours) and serves NHS trusts and hospital facilities teams across the region.

gaps.title: Limited asset visibility and utilization analytics
gaps.detail: The company rents mobile refrigeration units but there is no indication of IoT‑based location, tamper or utilization tracking, which could reduce idle time and improve fleet efficiency for fast‑response deployments.
gaps.based_on: Provides emergency and event fridge and freezer trailer hire with rapid on‑site response (within 4 hours).

pitch.angle:
- Highlight how ThinxFresh gives instant temperature alerts, keeping NHS and food‑service clients audit‑ready.
- Show a unified dashboard that lets Frostbite see every trailer’s temperature, location and usage in real time.
- Emphasise reduced downtime and liability by detecting deviations before product loss occurs.
- Offer a pilot with one of their high‑profile clients (e.g., a hospital) to prove ROI quickly.
pitch.opener: Hi [Name], noticed Frostbite’s rapid 4‑hour emergency fridge service – imagine adding live temperature alerts and usage analytics to keep those critical deliveries compliant and risk‑free.
